mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) for three consecutive months indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for three consecutive months, or interaction Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% for three consecutive months signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
